body:
Hello again!

The path into the grove is so muddy after the rain. I've brought a cart of stones, big ones and small ones.

Let's lay a stepping-stone path. I'll start the pattern, and you carry it on!
summary: Lay a stepping-stone path into the grove with Mr. Tobias.
done: The stepping-stone path is laid. No more muddy feet!

tasks.where: in the grove behind the chapel
